title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
At Anyscale, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We’re commercializing Ray, a popular open-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, Cruise, and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world.
  
  
With Anyscale, we’re building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert.
  
  
Proud to be backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition with $250+ million raised to date.
  
  
**About The Role**
Anyscale’s product security needs are growing as we ship to larger and more demanding customers. We’re looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to own our secure software development lifecycle and to be engineering’s partner on building security into the product. Reporting to the Head of Security, you will work in close partnership with engineering.
  
  
This is a senior, high-ownership role. You will own and operate a scalable SSDL, partner with engineering on security features and secure design, review the security of existing systems and new initiatives, and own how we find, track, drive to resolution and report on vulnerabilities in what we ship. This is a product security role with platform depth, not a cloud security role. This role is based in India.
  
  
In your first year, success looks like an SSDL that scales with engineering rather than gating it, including how we build with AI coding agents, security review embedded in how new initiatives ship, and accurate, on-demand vulnerability reporting backed by a working path to resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and operate a scalable secure software development lifecycle: threat modeling, security requirements, secure design practices, and scanning that engineering can readily adopt.
* Define how our SSDL works when AI writes and ships code: guardrails, review, and scanning for coding agents, MCP integrations, and LLM-powered features.
* Partner with engineering on security features and secure-by-design architecture, from early design through implementation.
* Extend product security down to the platform it runs on: cloud IAM and service roles, Kubernetes and container security, and service-to-service trust on the path to customer data.
* Review the security of existing systems and new initiatives, and turn findings into prioritized, actionable work.
* Own vulnerability management for what we ship: enumerate components, map known vulnerabilities, and produce accurate posture reporting on demand.
* Drive vulnerabilities to resolution with engineering against defined SLAs.
* Own software composition analysis, secret scanning, and SAST across product repositories, and set the bar for secure-development checks.
* Mentor other engineers and raise the security bar across the organization.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 8+ years in product or application security, with senior-level depth, ideally at a high-growth startup.
* Demonstrated ownership of a secure software development lifecycle at scale, including threat modeling and secure design review.
* A strong hands-on background partnering with engineering on security features and architecture, not just reporting findings.
* Hands-on cloud and Kubernetes security depth: cloud IAM and least privilege, container image security including scanning, signing, and SBOM generation, and secure service-to-service and cross-cloud trust. You’ve designed these, not just assessed them.
* Hands-on experience securing LLM features or agentic workflows, and a clear point of view on how secure development changes when agents are part of the team.
* Deep experience with software composition analysis, secret scanning, and SAST or secure-development tooling in real repositories.
* A solid understanding of software supply chain security and how to enumerate what an organization ships, including SBOM approaches.
* Experience triaging vulnerabilities using CVSS and business context and driving them to resolution with engineering.
* The communication and seniority to set direction, review others’ work, and raise the bar for those around you.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience producing vulnerability or security posture reporting for enterprise or regulated customers.
* Experience building or maturing an SSDL program at scale.
* Background in securing AI or ML platforms or distributed systems.

**Why Anyscale**

* We're on a mission to make scalable computing effortless. Ray is the AI Compute Engine at the center of some of the world's most powerful AI platforms
* Our tech is in production at companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, and Cruise
* We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition, with $250M+ raised to date
* Recent partnerships with Azure, CoreWeave, and Google Cloud are putting AI-native compute directly into enterprise environments
* Competitive salary and equity, plus health/dental/vision coverage (many plans up to 99% employer-covered)
* We offer flexible time off, paid parental leave, and mental health support

*Anyscale Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates are evaluated without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, disability, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law.*

***Notice of E-Verify Participation***
***and the***
***Right to Work posters in English and Spanish***

title: Principal Network Security Engineer
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD100041
  
  
**Position Overview**
Autodesk is seeking an experienced Principal Network Security Engineer to lead the design, architecture, and maturity of our global network security infrastructure and its security posture. In this role, you'll set the strategic direction for network security, drive improvements across our cloud and hybrid networks, implement foundation controls and partner with key stakeholders in our Enterprise IT organization to deliver Trust outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, architect, and plan strategy for deployment of Security technologies in a complex and distributed network infrastructure to mitigate risks
* Design, implement and manage scalable security controls on network security for Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, Intrusion Detection Systems, and auditing tools in both public and private cloud infrastructures
* Design, implement and manage scalable security controls for web application firewalling, bot protection, content redirection and manipulation in a hybrid public/private cloud
* Manage Security policies, standards and reviews of network segmentation and other cloud-based network services
* Develop and implement security protocols and procedures to prevent and mitigate potential threats in a cloud environment
* Support with responding to security breaches promptly, conduct thorough investigations, and propose long-term solutions at a network level
* Provide technical leadership and guidance in cloud network security matters
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure network security aligns with business objectives
* Work closely with all Trust stakeholders for alignment on design and strategy
* Develop automations to improve operational efficiency
* Support compliance and regular security audits, generate reports for evidence, and provide recommendations for improvements
* Stay abreast of the latest security trends, threats, and mitigation techniques

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least 8 years of network security experience, with a strong emphasis on cloud environments
* Expertise in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and Security capabilities offered by these platforms
* Knowledge of routing, load balancing and edge or perimeter network capabilities in cloud environments
* Proven experience with security technologies (firewalls, intrusion detection systems, SASE, NAC, WAF, DDoS protection etc.)
* Deep understanding and experience with DNS, NTP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VPN, SD-WAN, and other critical protocols
* Network monitoring and analytics tools (NetFlow, sFlow, packet analysis)
* AI/ML-powered network security — covering anomaly detection, threat prediction, automated remediation, and intelligent analytics
* Network configuration management and automation — covering IaC, Ansible, Terraform, GitOps, and NetOps/AIOps platforms
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices
* Familiarity with Security and Privacy compliance standards (SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, FedRamp etc.)
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (CISSP, CISM, etc.) are a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ability to influence stakeholders internal and external to Trust with design proposals and strategic recommendations
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

title: Senior Threat Intelligence Researcher
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to
**end cyber risk**
.
  
  
We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.
  
  
More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.
  
  
**About The Position**
We are looking for a
**Senior Threat Intelligence Researcher**
to help achieve this mission.
  
  
The Senior Threat Intelligence Researcher will contribute to our Threat Intelligence organization by leading advanced cyber threat intelligence research and translating adversary insights into measurable defensive outcomes. This role focuses on deep technical analysis, adversary tracking, intelligence-driven detection, and operational collaboration to improve threat visibility, detection coverage, and incident response effectiveness across the organization.
  
  
As a senior technical authority, this role will shape intelligence methodologies, establish analytical standards, mentor peers, and deliver actionable intelligence that directly strengthens Arctic Wolf’s security operations and customer protection capabilities.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Threat Intelligence Research and Adversary Tracking**

* Lead and contribute to threat actor, malware family, and campaign tracking by correlating malware samples, infrastructure, delivery mechanisms, and adversary tradecraft.
* Own end-to-end cyber threat intelligence investigations, from initial research and hypothesis development through validation, reporting, and operational implementation.
* Conduct cyber threat intelligence research aligned with established frameworks such as the Cyber Threat Intelligence lifecycle, MITRE ATT&CK, and the Diamond Model.
* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis across malicious binaries, scripts, and document-based delivery mechanisms.
* Investigate malicious network infrastructure and command-and-control activity by pivoting across domains, Internet Protocol addresses, certificates, and related artifacts.
* Apply advanced open-source intelligence techniques, pivoting methodologies, and enrichment across multiple intelligence platforms and data sources.
* Research Deep Web ecosystems, including crimeware-as-a-service and ransomware-as-a-service operations, to identify emerging threats, adversary relationships, and evolving attack methodologies.
* Analyze Windows and macOS internals, including application programming interfaces, obfuscation techniques, system calls, and execution behaviors.
* Analyze and correlate large-scale datasets using Structured Query Language, Python, or Excel to identify patterns, generate actionable intelligence, and support evidence-based decisions.

**Intelligence-to-Detection and Operational Impact**

* Translate intelligence findings into actionable detection and threat hunting logic using technologies such as YARA, Sigma, and Suricata.
* Own the lifecycle of intelligence-driven detection improvements, from identifying intelligence gaps and developing detection hypotheses to validating coverage and measuring operational effectiveness.
* Take accountability for ensuring that intelligence findings are translated into practical defensive improvements rather than remaining limited to research reports or theoretical assessments.
* Develop intelligence-to-detection feedback loops that identify coverage gaps, assess detection effectiveness, and continuously improve defensive capabilities.
* Partner closely with Security Operations Center and Managed Detection and Response teams to operationalize intelligence into detection, triage, investigation, and response workflows.
* Provide escalation support for high-confidence threat events, including intelligence enrichment, attribution context, assessment of potential impact, and recommended response actions.
* Contribute real-time intelligence support during active incidents and investigations, ensuring findings are communicated promptly and translated into actionable recommendations.
* Support Request for Intelligence workflows by owning assigned requests from initial assessment through research, delivery, and follow-up, ensuring that outputs address the operational team's requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of intelligence-led initiatives using measurable outcomes such as detection coverage, investigation efficiency, escalation quality, and response time improvements.

**Automation, Scalability, and Analytical Excellence**

* Develop automation and enrichment workflows using scripting languages such as Python to improve research efficiency, data quality, and intelligence delivery.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual activities and build scalable intelligence workflows that support growing operational requirements.
* Own the implementation and continuous improvement of assigned automation initiatives, ensuring they deliver measurable efficiency gains and remain reliable in production environments.
* Establish repeatable research methodologies, intelligence validation practices, and analytical standards to improve consistency, accuracy, and reproducibility.
* Analyze operational feedback, detection gaps, and intelligence quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on their potential security impact.
* Create scalable intelligence dissemination methods, including threat alerts, intelligence briefs, technical reports, and knowledge base updates, ensuring that relevant teams receive timely and actionable information.

**Collaboration, Technical Leadership, and Knowledge Sharing**

* Collaborate with Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, Incident Response, Security Operations Center, and Managed Detection and Response teams to align intelligence priorities with operational and customer security needs.
* Take ownership of assigned intelligence initiatives and drive them forward independently, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to resolve dependencies and achieve agreed outcomes.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, share investigative techniques, and contribute to the development of technical standards within the research organization.
* Communicate complex technical findings clearly to technical and operational audiences, ensuring that recommendations are understood, actionable, and aligned with business priorities.
* Publish technical research, tradecraft methodologies, blogs, and whitepapers, or present findings at industry workshops and conferences.
* Stay informed about emerging adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, assess their relevance to Arctic Wolf customers, and proactively recommend improvements to intelligence coverage and defensive capabilities.

**You Will Be Successful In This Role If**

* You have 5+ years of relevant experience and are recognized as a technical authority within one or more adversary ecosystems, such as ransomware, financially motivated crimeware, or nation-state operations.
* You have strong experience in cyber threat intelligence research, adversary tracking, and intelligence analysis.
* You have hands-on experience applying threat intelligence to detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, or threat modeling.
* You have experience with malware analysis tooling, host telemetry, and network telemetry analysis.
* You possess strong knowledge of modern threat intelligence frameworks, analytical methodologies, and adversary research techniques.
* You demonstrate end-to-end ownership by independently driving investigations and intelligence initiatives from problem identification through execution, validation, and measurable outcomes.
* You can translate complex intelligence findings into actionable recommendations and demonstrate how your work improves detection coverage, investigation quality, or defensive capabilities.
* You take accountability for the quality, accuracy, timeliness, and operational relevance of your intelligence deliverables.
* You proactively identify gaps in intelligence coverage, investigative processes, and detection capabilities, and drive improvements without waiting for predefined instructions.
* You are comfortable working independently in ambiguous, fast-changing threat environments, making informed decisions, and adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
* You have strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and their operational implications.
* You have experience mentoring peers, sharing technical expertise, and contributing to research standards and best practices.
* You are passionate about improving intelligence-driven security operations and delivering measurable improvements to customer security outcomes.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience publishing threat research, whitepapers, or presenting at industry conferences.
* Experience collaborating with external intelligence-sharing communities or trusted industry partners.
* Experience building scalable threat intelligence workflows, enrichment pipelines, and operational frameworks.
* Familiarity with large-scale telemetry analysis and data science methodologies.
* Experience automating intelligence research, enrichment, and analysis workflows.

title: GRC Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

GRC Specialist to execute the day-to-day work that keeps our compliance and risk programs running — from responding to customer security questionnaires to supporting audits and assessing vendor risk. You'll work closely with Engineering, IT, Sales and Customer Success to turn security and compliance requirements into clear, evidenced answers, while the GRC Lead sets overall program strategy and priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Customer RFP & Security Questionnaire Response**
  — Own end-to-end responses to inbound customer RFPs, RFIs, and CAIQs, coordinating with internal teams to gather accurate, evidence-backed answers that support sales and customer success deal cycles.
* **Risk Assessment & Management**
  — Conduct risk assessments and control validation testing against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST; maintain the risk register, score identified risks, and track treatment items through to closure.
* **Audit & Compliance Support**
  — Support the full lifecycle of SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits, including evidence collection, control walkthroughs, and remediation tracking, in coordination with internal stakeholders and external auditors.
* **Third-Party & Vendor Risk Management**
  — Conduct vendor security assessments and review vendor questionnaire responses to evaluate third-party risk posture.
* **Trust Centre Maintenance**
  — Keep customer-facing certifications, policies, and security documentation current and accurate.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination**
  — Partner with Engineering, IT, Legal, and Privacy teams to resolve findings and validate control implementations.
* **Metrics & Reporting**
  — Track and report on risk, incident, vulnerability, and control metrics, clearly explaining changes and next steps to stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of experience in a GRC, IT audit, information security, or compliance-related role.
* Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, PCI DSS, or similar).
* Experience with GRC tooling (e.g., Scrut/Vanta/Drata)
* Strong written communication skills — able to translate technical controls into clear answers for customers and auditors.
* Comfort managing multiple concurrent requests under deal-cycle timelines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
* Prior experience responding to customer security questionnaires in a SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with IT/cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) and vendor risk assessment methodologies.

**Job Details**
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Information Security Associate – Risk Operations**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Who We Are And Where We're Going**
**Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline.**
Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We're replacing that model with one that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.
  
  
**Our Strategy**
**Risk-informed, control managed.**
We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. This proves trust while delivering risk operations, compliance artifacts, and outputs, and it opens access to new markets through the product we build and the behavior we change.
  
  
**Visibility and invention.**
We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. We equip the Assurance team with a new way of protecting Salesforce, through the invention we create together. We also invest in the people who work here, with room to grow, take on new challenges, and drive excellence.
  
  
**Always in front.**
We turn gaps into signals, alerts, and escalations. When a control fails, it flows into a workflow built to help stakeholders meet their trust obligations. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.
  
  
We're hiring people who want to build this future. You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do …**
Risk Operations provides a centralized approach to identifying, prioritizing, and managing cybersecurity risks, driving accountability, faster decision-making, and measurable risk reduction. The team partners across security, engineering, and business functions to streamline risk management processes, improve visibility into risk exposure, and ensure timely escalation and resolution.
  
  
We're looking for an Information Security Associate who is excited to help build and support a growing Risk Operations function. In this role, you'll be at the center of day-to-day security issue and exception management activities, helping ensure risk cases are accurately documented, efficiently processed, and consistently tracked through resolution. You'll work closely with experienced risk and security professionals while contributing to the development of workflows, processes, and reporting that will help shape how Risk Operations operates at scale.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for an early-career security professional who enjoys solving problems, bringing organization to complex processes, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  
  

* Rapid Decision Management: We work in a business. Predictability and rapid decisions are the core outcomes you’ll bring to the job. Support rapid risk decision-making by coordinating timely reviews, approvals, and escalations, ensuring decision-makers have the information needed to assess risks and take action.
* Support day-to-day security risk operations by managing the intake, triage, and tracking of security issues and exceptions to accelerate risk-based decisions and timely resolution.
* Coordinate issue and exception management activities, including reviewing submissions for completeness, following up with stakeholders, tracking remediation commitments, monitoring exception expiration dates, and supporting timely case resolution.
* Maintain accurate and complete risk records in case management platforms, ensuring consistent documentation, appropriate case status, and reliable data for operational reporting.
* Partner with security, engineering, and compliance teams to gather information, clarify case requirements, resolve operational blockers, and accelerate risk-based decision-making by ensuring stakeholders have the information, context, and visibility needed to take timely action.
* Support timely risk decisions and escalations by monitoring case progress, identifying stalled requests or decision gaps, and coordinating follow-ups to ensure issues and exceptions move efficiently through established governance and approval workflows.
* Assist with operational reporting and metrics, including tracking case volumes, aging, remediation progress, exception renewals, and other key performance indicators to provide visibility into risk operations activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate repetitive tasks, helping streamline case handling, improve data quality, and enhance the overall stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to broader Risk Operations initiatives by supporting ad hoc requests, process improvements, and emerging operational needs as the team establishes and matures its capabilities.

**What You Bring ...**

* You have +2 years of experience in information security or security operations, or a related field.
* You have a foundational understanding of information security concepts, including security findings, risk remediation, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance.
* You have sufficient technical ability to serve as one of many eyes as we assess the certainty of our compensating controls and exposures.
* You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities while maintaining accurate records.
* You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information for completeness, identify inconsistencies, and recognize when issues require additional attention or escalation.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, clarify requirements, and drive timely follow-through.
* You are comfortable learning new tools, navigating workflow or ticketing systems, and working with spreadsheets and data to support operational activities.
* You are adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes and responsibilities are still being established.
* You have a continuous improvement mindset and are eager to learn, contribute ideas, and help build scalable and efficient security risk management practices.

**How We Work**

* Engineering-first culture. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
* Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
* Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
* Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
* Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
* Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.

**Modern Tooling Acumen**
Direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. Must be able to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes.
  
  
Graduates need direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. This is a newer requirement; candidates who have actively experimented with and used tools like Gemini, Cursor, or other agent-based frameworks will be stronger candidates.

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

what you will do ?

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence
* lead and participate in incident response, performing root-cause analysis and driving preventive improvements post-incident
* develop and enhance the CRED’s detection, monitoring and response capabilities
* automate incident response workflows using playbooks and orchestration to reduce manual effort
* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats
* assist with creating security awareness and maintaining prudent security engineering culture within an organization
* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

you should apply if you have:

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response
* hands-on experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud (aws preferred), endpoint (windows/linux/macOS), and network telemetry
* exposure to EDR, IDS/IPS, and SIEM / centralized logging platforms (splunk, ELK, sentinel, or similar), including building high-fidelity detection pipelines
* proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (python, go, or bash)
* solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and diamond model
* ability to design and tune detection rules using MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence with a focus on signal quality
* experience with threat hunting, automation and enrichment, regex creation, and false-positive reduction
* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch

title: Cyber Defense Engineering II - Endpoint Protection
description:
**Role Overview**
You will become a key member of Cyber Defense Engineering - Endpoint Protection team and will support senior colleagues in configuring and maintaining security controls across the endpoint security domain. Your primary goal is to ensure 100% endpoint security agent deployment, visibility and control enforcement compliance across the enterprise.
  
  
This will primarily involve: managing endpoint security agent health, deploying and troubleshooting agent version upgrades and security content updates, refining AV / EDR policy configurations and exclusions to reduce "noise" while maintaining high security posture.
  
  
Additionally, you will play a hands-on role in ensuring seamless, secure, and performant enterprise-wide AV / EDR control migrations between industry-leading platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Endpoint Security Agent Management: Work with your Cyber Defense colleagues as well as Desktop, Server, Cloud Compute engineering and other technology teams as required to deploy, update, and troubleshoot endpoint security agents across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoint environments.
* Platform Management: Assist in driving enterprise-wide deployments and migrations of next-generation AV / EDR controls, ensuring consistent coverage during transition periods.
* Policy Administration: Assist with the configuration and maintenance of all policies in the endpoint security control domain, primarily including: prevention, detection and response, device control, security content updates, exclusions, network containment and host-based firewall rules management.
* Health Monitoring: Proactively identify and resolve incidents of non-compliant compute endpoints with unhealthy endpoint security agent states.
* Issue Resolution (Tier 1/2 ticket management): Monitor the Cyber Defense Engineering - Endpoint Protection ticket queue, taking ownership of tier 1/2 operational support requests and incidents.
* Exclusion Tuning: Work with system owners as required to configure and maintain narrowly defined AV / EDR exclusions to prevent false positives without creating security gaps, while also ensuring system performance.
* Documentation: Upkeep of the team’s internal knowledgebase including all documentation pages and standard operating procedures (SOPs) relating to endpoint security agent and platform management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Technical Skills & Work Experience**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or 2-4 years of equivalent hands-on experience in IT security, systems support, or engineering related roles).
* OS Fundamentals: Strong grasp of Windows, Mac, and Linux operating system internals, command-line usage and log analysis.
* Scripting: Basic proficiency in at least two common scripting languages (e.g. PowerShell for Windows environments, Bash for Linux/macOS environments, Python for cross-platform support).
* Networking: Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP and DNS (e.g. how endpoints communicate across enterprise networks, how endpoint security agents communicate with cloud-based cybersecurity platforms).
* Industry Certifications:

○ Foundational IT security certifications (e.g. CompTIA Security+)
  
  
○ Endpoint security administration oriented certifications are highly preferred / desirable.
  
  
**Professional & Soft Skills**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong communication skills with the ability to navigate complex enterprise IT ecosystems and work effectively with other teams and system owners to enforce endpoint security control compliance.
* Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically during issue / incident triage and perform root-cause analysis (For example: when troubleshooting endpoint security agent health issues).
* Adaptability & Time Management: Capable of balancing day-to-day operational support and incident ticket queues with long-term, enterprise-wide platform maturity efforts.

**What Makes a Candidate Stand Out?**

* Enterprise Platform Experience: Hands-on experience supporting enterprise-grade cybersecurity and/or IT systems management platforms and controls at scale.
* Familiarity with SIEM Query Languages: Working knowledge of one or more SIEM query language for querying endpoint telemetry data (e.g. SPL, KQL, CQL, or UDM Search/YARA-L).
* API Knowledge: Practical experience of using cybersecurity and/or IT systems management platform APIs for script development (e.g. for report generation and workflow automation).b

title: HR Technology Security Analyst
description:
**Description -**
**Job Summary**
HR Systems enables secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions that power the employee experience across HP's global workforce. As part of the HR Technology organization, the HR Systems Security Analyst serves as a recognized expert in Workday Security, HR technology governance, and identity and access management.
  
  
This role is responsible for the strategy, design, implementation, and continuous improvement of security and access controls across Workday and other HR technology platforms. The position partners closely with HR, HRIT, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Compliance, Audit, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, compliant, and efficient solutions that support business objectives while safeguarding employee data.
  
  
Working on highly complex initiatives, this role leads access governance programs, security architecture enhancements, automation efforts, and enterprise-wide projects that strengthen compliance, reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the employee experience. As a trusted advisor, the HR Systems Security Analyst influences governance practices, drives process improvements, and provides thought leadership in support of HP's evolving HR technology ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, configuration, implementation, and governance of security frameworks across Workday and other HR technology platforms, ensuring scalable, compliant, and efficient access management solutions.
* Define, implement, and maintain role-based access models, security groups, domain policies, business process security policies, and governance standards.
* Serve as a trusted subject matter expert and advisor for complex access management requirements, escalations, and enterprise initiatives.
* Lead all phases of the solution lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing production support.
* Partner with HR, HRIT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Audit teams to ensure alignment with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and security best practices.
* Lead and oversee SOX compliance activities, access certifications, audit reviews, segregation-of-duties (SoD) assessments, and risk mitigation programs across HR technology platforms.
* Assess security and compliance risks and develop solutions that effectively balance business needs, user experience, and governance requirements.
* Drive enterprise access management initiatives, including Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), provisioning, deprovisioning, role optimization, and automation capabilities.
* Collaborate with enterprise Identity and Access Management teams to establish long-term access governance strategies, role optimization frameworks, and automation capabilities that enhance security, compliance, and user experience.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes and implement scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, compliance, and the employee experience.
* Lead HR technology security planning and execution for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, reorganizations, and other business transformation initiatives.
* Investigate and resolve complex access, security, and system-related issues while ensuring timely and effective remediation.
* Develop and maintain governance documentation, standards, operating procedures, training materials, and support resources.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to team members while fostering knowledge sharing and capability development across the organization.
* Represent HR Systems Security in executive reviews, compliance discussions, vendor engagements, and cross-functional project teams.
* Champion continuous improvement through automation, workflow optimization, reporting, analytics, and data-driven decision-making.

**Education And Experience Required**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
**Senior Cloud Security Engineer**

**Department:**
Security Engineering

**Function:**
Security Engineering and Operations

**Reports To:**
Manager

**Location:**
Bangalore, India

**Job Description**

Rakuten Symphony is seeking a hands-on Senior Cloud Security Engineer to support security engineering and security operations for applications, cloud infrastructure, network platforms, and on-premises environments. The role will be responsible for implementing and operating security controls, configuring firewalls and WAFs, monitoring security events, investigating incidents, managing vulnerabilities, and improving the security posture of production environments. Experience with AWS and GCP security services is preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement, operate, and continuously improve security controls for applications, cloud infrastructure, servers, networks, and platforms.
* Configure and manage security technologies including firewalls, WAFs, F5 security solutions, Cisco security solutions, network access controls, and traffic-filtering policies.
* Configure and maintain AWS WAF, GCP Cloud Armor, F5 Advanced WAF, and equivalent technologies.
* Configure and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP security features, including virtual servers, access policies, SSL/TLS controls, traffic management, and WAF policies.
* Configure and manage relevant Cisco security technologies, including firewalls, network security controls, VPNs, access policies, and security monitoring.
* Develop and tune security rules to protect applications and APIs from SQL injection, cross-site scripting, path traversal, bot activity, denial-of-service attacks, and other malicious traffic.
* Monitor firewall, WAF, F5, Cisco, operating system, application, network, cloud, and security logs.
* Investigate security alerts, suspicious traffic, unauthorized access, abnormal application behavior, and potential indicators of compromise.
* Support security incident response, including analysis, containment, recovery, and post-incident improvement.
* Investigate compromised accounts, service accounts, cloud credentials, servers, containers, and application workloads.
* Implement and review identity and access management controls across cloud, network, Linux, and application environments.
* Perform security hardening and vulnerability remediation for Linux servers, virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes platforms, and cloud workloads.
* Support the secure operation of on-premises Kubernetes and managed cloud Kubernetes environments.
* Review Kubernetes configurations, workload permissions, ingress controls, secrets, container images, and exposed services.
* Perform security posture reviews and track remediation of identified weaknesses.
* Analyze findings from vulnerability scanners, security-monitoring tools, cloud security tools, penetration tests, and configuration reviews.
* Develop scripts and automation to support security monitoring, investigation, alert handling, rule deployment, and security validation.
* Support integration with SIEM, vulnerability-management, endpoint-security, and incident-response platforms.
* Participate in threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and security design reviews.
* Review application and infrastructure changes to ensure appropriate security controls are implemented before deployment.
* Work with application, DevOps, SRE, platform, network, infrastructure, and SOC teams to address security risks.
* Maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, technical standards, and operational documentation.
* Support security audits, compliance activities, evidence collection, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **5–8 years of experience in security engineering, security operations, network security, infrastructure security, or cybersecurity.**
* Strong hands-on experience in security monitoring, incident investigation, vulnerability management, system hardening, and security control implementation.
* Experience configuring and managing firewalls, WAFs, F5, Cisco security technologies, IAM, network controls, logging, and monitoring tools.
* **Experience with AWS or GCP security services is preferred.**
* Practical experience with AWS WAF, AWS IAM, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, or equivalent AWS services.
* Experience with GCP Cloud Armor, GCP IAM, VPC firewall rules, Cloud Audit Logs, or equivalent GCP services is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP, F5 Advanced WAF, Cisco firewalls, Cisco VPN, or related security technologies.
* Good knowledge of Linux security, hardening, patching, access control, and troubleshooting.
* **Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, containers, and container security.**
* Good understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP, routing, load balancers, reverse proxies, and network segmentation.
* Experience analyzing security logs and investigating suspicious events.
* Understanding of common attacks, including credential compromise, privilege escalation, malware, API abuse, SQL injection, cross-site scripting, SSRF, data exfiltration, and denial-of-service attacks.
* Experience with Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.
* Experience with SIEM, vulnerability-management, endpoint-security, or security-monitoring platforms.
* Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure deployment tools.
* Strong problem-solving, incident-handling, communication, and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS Certified Security or equivalent certification.
* Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer certification.
* F5 or Cisco security certification.
* CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent security certification.
* Experience securing on-premises Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, or Google Kubernetes Engine.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, API security, and cloud-native security.
* Experience with penetration testing, threat hunting, or adversary simulation.
* Experience in telecom, distributed systems, microservices, or highly available production environments.

**Role Summary**

Responsible for security engineering and security operations across applications, infrastructure, Linux, Kubernetes, and cloud environments, including security monitoring, incident response, firewalls, WAF, IAM, vulnerability management, hardening, and security automation. Experience with AWS and GCP security services is preferred.

**RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:**

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

* **Always improve, always advance.**
  Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.
* **Be passionately professional.**
  Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
* **Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika.**
  Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
* **Maximize Customer Satisfaction.**
  The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
* **Speed!! Speed!! Speed!!**
  Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

title: Senior Information Security Risk Analyst
description:
**About Fam (previously FamPay)**

  

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
  
  
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
  
  
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

  
  

**Role Overview**
We are seeking a proactive and detailed-oriented IT Risk & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for executing cybersecurity risk assessments for our third-party vendors, suppliers, service providers and internal IT risk management processes. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Risk teams to identify, evaluate, and mitigate technology and vendor risks across the organization.
  
  
**Must-Haves**

  

  
* **Experience:**
  3 to 5 years of dedicated experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity, third-party risk management (TPRM), or information security governance

  Strong understanding of internal IT general controls (ITGC), access control, disaster recovery, cloud security concepts, and data protection principles
  
* **Framework Familiarity:**
  Working knowledge of industry frameworks and standards, such as RBI Framework for Outsourcing of Payment and Settlement-related Activities by PSOs, RBI MD on Cyber Resilience & Digital Payment Security Controls, ISO 27001, ISO 31000, and NIST CSF
  
* **Artifact Evaluation:**
  Demonstrated ability to review vendor reports, security certifications, penetration test summaries, and questionnaires
  
* **Analytical & Communication Skills:**
  Excellent analytical, organizational, and documentation skills with the ability to communicate risk findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders
  
* **Ownership:**
  Proven ability to manage multiple vendor assessments and internal risk tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  
  

  

**Good to Haves**
  

  
* Professional certifications or active progress toward certifications such as
  **CISA**
  ,
  **CRISC**
  ,
  **ISO 27001 LA/LI**
  etc
  
* Prior experience working in financial services, technology, or other regulated environments
  
* Hands-on experience using GRC tools or dedicated Third-Party Risk Management platforms
  
* Basic awareness of AI-enabled features in GRC or risk tools
  
* Experience supporting IT disaster recovery exercises or business continuity planning.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**
  

**1. IT Risk Management**

  

  
* **Risk Assessment & Identification:**
  Execute internal IT risk assessments across IT infrastructure, cloud environments, business applications, and operational workflows
  
* **Risk Register Maintenance:**
  Maintain and regularly update the enterprise IT Risk Register, tracking risk treatment plans, remediation timelines, and risk acceptance approvals
  
* **Internal Controls Evaluation:**
  Assess the effectiveness of internal IT controls, including access management, backup and disaster recovery, change management, and data security
  
* **KRI & Risk Reporting:**
  Monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and assist in preparing periodic risk reports and metrics for management and oversight committees
  
  

  
  

**2. Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPRM)**

  

  
* **Vendor Risk Assessments:**
  Perform end-to-end cybersecurity risk assessments for third-party vendors, suppliers, and external service providers
  
* **Artefact Review & Analysis:**
  Review vendor security documentation, including reports, certifications, penetration testing summaries, architecture diagrams, and security policies
  
* **Questionnaire Evaluation:**
  Review and evaluate vendor responses to cybersecurity questionnaires, due diligence requests, and risk evaluations
  
* **Risk Quantification & Tracking:**
  Assign vendor risk ratings, document identified gaps, establish remediation action plans, and track vendor progress on outstanding risk items
  
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with Procurement, Legal, and stakeholder teams during vendor onboarding, ongoing monitoring, and contract reviews
  
* **Incident Monitoring & Escalation:**
  Monitor vendor-related security incidents and advisory alerts, escalating potential issues in accordance with incident response protocols.
  
  

  
**Why Join Us**
  

* **High ownership:**
  Define and drive Fam’s IT risk posture from the ground up—shaping IT, IS & outsourcing risk frameworks
  
* **Org-level impact:**
  Influence decision-making at the highest levels, working cross-functionally with security, legal, engineering, vendors and leadership to embed a strong risk and compliance culture across the org
  
* **Zero to one opportunity:**
  Build scalable, audit-ready systems and processes in a fast-moving startup environment where your work directly enables product innovation and regulatory trust
  
* **Mission-driven:**
  Be part of India’s first payments platform purpose-built for teenagers and young adults—balancing growth with trust, responsibility, and user safety

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

**Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck**

  

• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.

  

• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).

  

• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.

  

• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

  

• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.

  

• Access the latest gadgets and tools.

  

• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.

  

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

  

• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.

  
  

**Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️**

  

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.

  
  

**Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech**

  

FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.

  
  

**Trusted by leading investors**

  

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.

  
  

**Join Our Dynamic Team**

  

At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.

  
  

Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
  
  
**PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.**

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

title: Ping Federate - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading the technical design, setup, and integration of Ping Identity solutions across cloud and on-premises client environments
* Installing, upgrading, and configuring PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, and PingOne products in clustered environments
* Gathering business and technical requirements from client stakeholders and translating them into scalable identity and access management solution designs
* Planning and executing integration, performance, and user acceptance testing, and troubleshooting advanced integration issues with internal and vendor support teams
* Creating technical, architectural, administrator, and end-user documentation to support deployment, maintenance, and adoption
* Supporting compliance with client security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards throughout the deployment lifecycle

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24x7 rotational shifts; flexibility for night, weekend, and holiday coverage; on-call support based on project assignment
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience with at least 2 Ping products, including PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, or PingOne
* Experience architecting and deploying Ping Identity solutions that support authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and policy enforcement
* Experience configuring single sign-on (SSO) and federation integrations using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Experience deploying and upgrading PingFederate, PingOne, PingAccess, or PingDirectory in customer environments, including migrations and clustering for high availability
* Experience configuring Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) connections, including Active Directory or OpenLDAP, for authentication and directory lookups
* Experience customizing authentication policies, adapters, token mapping rules, and workflows within Ping Identity products
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Ping Identity certification
* Experience with certificate management and secure key handling
* Experience integrating with Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, or cloud directories
* Experience with Java, JavaScript, HyperText Markup Language (HTML), or Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, or Shell scripting for deployment automation
* Experience with user provisioning or System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) integrations in PingOne or PingFederate

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Customer Experience Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
The Security Customer Experience Engineer is a highly customer-connected engineering role within Microsoft Security, focused on the Microsoft Defender portfolio. This role carries end-to-end ownership of high-impact, mission-critical customer escalations, ensuring not only timely resolution but also sustained customer confidence during complex and sensitive situations. Beyond resolving incidents, the engineer plays a strategic role in strengthening product reliability and supportability by working closely with Engineering and Product teams, translating real-world customer challenges into actionable improvements that enhance overall service quality and trust. The position extends well beyond traditional escalation management. It actively contributes to transforming our team within Customer Value Creation from a reactive, case-driven function into a proactive, intelligence-led execution model. By identifying patterns, driving structured feedback loops, and enabling preventative improvements, the engineer helps improve customer outcomes, accelerate engineering responsiveness, and elevate operational efficiency across the organization. Success in this role requires deep technical expertise across security and compliance technologies, strong customer empathy, executive-level communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and high-pressure environments with clarity, composure, and accountability.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Escalation Ownership
  
  

* Own and drive resolution of mission-critical escalations for Microsoft Defender customers in a 24x7x365 environment.
* Engage directly with customers via phone, email, and web channels, providing clear, structured, and confident updates during high-severity incidents.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor during complex, sensitive, and high-pressure situations.
* Restore and maintain customer confidence through transparency, accountability, and structured problem-solving. 2. Deep Technical Problem Solving
* Diagnose and resolve complex issues across the Microsoft Defender suite, including:
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Microsoft Defender for Cloud
* Microsoft Defender for Office
* Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Solution Architects, and Support Engineers to deliver durable, high-quality resolutions.
* Maintain strong hands-on technical depth and continuously expand expertise in Microsoft Security and Compliance technologies. 3. Product Feedback & Continuous Improvement
* Translate customer escalations and issue patterns into actionable insights for Engineering and Product teams.
* Contribute to improvements in product reliability, diagnostics, documentation, and self-remediation guidance.
* Participate in feature readiness reviews, validation testing, and design discussions to prevent future customer impact.
* Influence product design and supportability by representing real customer experiences. 4. Operational Excellence & Proactive Practices
* Apply structured, repeatable approaches to escalation management to improve consistency and time-to-mitigation.
* Identify recurring product or customer pain points and propose proactive improvements, automation strategies, and AI-assisted practices.
* Leverage modern tooling, including AI-based investigation and summarization capabilities, to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Help scale best practices across teams to reduce recurrence and operational friction. 5. Collaboration & Team Enablement
* Partner across Engineering, CSS, CSU, Account Teams, Product Management, and UX to ensure aligned customer outcomes.
* Share knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned to elevate technical capability across the organization.
* Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**
Required/minimum qualifications - Bachelor's Degree Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND 2+ years experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Other Requirements**
Other Requirements
  
  
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
  
  

* This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional or preferred qualifications - Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND 5+ years experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering OR equivalent experience. 1+ year(s) of customer facing experience.
  
  
**#MSFTSecurity**
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Professional Services Consultant- EMEA
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Professional Services Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid, Bangalore role , reporting to the Senior Manager, Professional Services. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical authority for our enterprise customers — architecting, deploying, and optimizing solutions across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and increasingly complex hybrid environments, you will be the expert who turns that complexity into clarity. You bring deep technical depth, a strategic consulting mindset, and the ability to engage equally well with hands-on engineering teams and senior business stakeholders — delivering outcomes that are secure, scalable, and built to last.Work Shift: EMEA time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Own the full technical engagement lifecycle for enterprise customers — from discovery and solution design through deployment, adoption, and continuous optimization
* Architect and integrate ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange across complex, multi-cloud and hybrid enterprise environments including AI-driven workload scenarios
* Lead Zero Trust maturity assessments, technical discovery workshops, and migration planning sessions with customer and partner stakeholders at all levels
* Guide customers on securing modern identity frameworks, SaaS ecosystems, and AI-powered workflows — translating evolving threat landscapes into actionable, platform-led security outcomes
* Partner with sales, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact consultancy and deployment services that accelerate customer time-to-value

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
