* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) solutions (e.g., Terraform) for firewall policy deployment and lifecycle management
* Contribute to Agile development practices, including designing, testing, debugging, and documenting automation and infrastructure solutions
* Make key technical decisions on architecture, implementation approaches, and risk mitigation strategies, while identifying resource and capacity needs
* Direct and support operational risk and control activities, ensuring adherence to enterprise policies, regulatory standards, and audit requirements

* Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls (VM-Series, Panorama, policy management)

* Strong understanding of cloud networking concepts (VPC/VNet, routing, NAT, load balancing, segmentation)
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, CI/CD pipelines)
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network and security issues across distributed environments
* Experience working in regulated environments with strong risk, compliance, and control requirements
* Strong knowledge of network security principles, including zero trust, segmentation, and threat prevention

* Experience integrating firewalls with identity systems (e.g., TACACS, SSO, IAM)
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to financial services (e.g., FFIEC, SOX, PCI)
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure SDLC integration
* Palo Alto certifications (PCNSA, PCNSE)
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to senior stakeholders

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. title: Senior Identity Engineer - IGA Consultant with Java Experience
description:
About the Role:
  
  
The IAM IGA Consultant with Java Experience is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions for enterprise clients. This role involves working across the entire lifecycle of IGA solutions, including requirements gathering, solution design, system integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. The consultant will leverage strong Java development expertise to build custom integrations, workflows, and connectors that enhance governance capabilities and support secure identity lifecycle management across enterprise environments.
  
  
What You'll Do:
  
  

* Lead the implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions, including user identity and access lifecycle management, role-based access control (RBAC), entitlement management, and policy enforcement
* Analyze and define business requirements, translating them into functional and technical specifications
* Configure and customize IGA platforms according to business and security requirements
* Design and implement identity management workflows, access request processes, and automated provisioning and deprovisioning
* Conduct system integrations with enterprise applications, HR systems, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and other business systems
* Develop and implement Java-based solutions to support and extend IGA platform capabilities
* Build custom connectors and integrations between IGA solutions and enterprise applications using Java frameworks and libraries
* Write, test, and maintain Java code to ensure reliable integration and functionality across multiple systems
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Java-based integrations, connectors, and workflows
* Work closely with stakeholders to understand identity governance requirements and provide guidance on industry best practices
* Conduct workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions on identity governance, access management, and security practices
* Provide ongoing support and maintenance for IGA solutions, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and upgrades
* Ensure IGA solutions adhere to security standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices
* Collaborate with security and compliance teams to implement governance controls, access policies, and audit requirements
* Manage multiple implementation projects while ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes
* Mentor junior consultants and developers, sharing knowledge and implementation best practices

What You Bring:
  
  

* 7+ years of hands-on experience in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) consulting, implementation, or support
* Strong experience implementing and supporting enterprise identity governance solutions
* 5+ years of Java development experience focused on backend development and system integrations
* Deep understanding of identity and access management concepts, including RBAC, user lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, entitlement management, and governance controls
* Experience working with Identity Governance platforms such as SailPoint, Saviynt, One Identity, or similar solutions
* Strong experience integrating identity solutions with enterprise applications, directories, databases, and cloud platforms
* Proficiency in Java development, including frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, and J2EE
* Experience with RESTful APIs, SOAP/REST web services, and third-party system integrations
* Strong knowledge of LDAP, Active Directory, IAM protocols including SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect
* Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or SQL Server
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment
* Experience working in Agile development environments

Nice to Have:
  
  

* Experience with cloud identity and access management solutions
* Knowledge of scripting technologies such as PowerShell, JavaScript, or BeanShell
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Understanding of access certification campaigns, segregation of duties (SoD), and identity governance reporting
* Relevant certifications in Identity and Access Management, Java, Cloud Technologies, or Information Security

description:

**Job Description**
Patch Management – Workstation Patching Engineer
  
  
**Value Proposition**
As a Patch Engineer, this role is integral to leading enterprise-wide patch management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance initiatives. The position leverages advanced expertise in BigFix, MECM and vulnerability scanning tools like Qualys to secure enterprise systems. The patch engineer will play a technical role along with mentoring teams for technical issues and help automate patching processes for improved efficiency and robust compliance.
  
  
**Job Details**
Position Title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
Career Level: P3
  
  
Job Category : Manager
  
  
Role Type: Hybrid
  
  
Job Location: Bangalore
  
  
**About The Team**
First Citizens Bank is one of the top financial services providers, recognized and awarded for our customer satisfaction, sustainable profitability, and overall stability and security. Our associates make First Citizens Bank a great place for our clients to do business. Those who grow, achieve and succeed with First Citizens Bank are those who share our core values of integrity, service excellence and stability.
  
  
The patch management team is a cross-functional group focused on maintaining, optimizing, and securing enterprise endpoints. The team collaborates with IT security, infrastructure, and operations teams, working under critical deadlines to ensure uptime and compliance. Members contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence
  
  
**Impact**
This Patch Engineer position is essential for enforcing security standards, ensuring compliance, and protecting the organization from threats. The role is pivotal in setting up automation and best practices in patching, participating in vulnerability remediation, and providing direction and mentorship to junior associates
  
  
**Key Deliverables**

* Advanced Patch Management: Plan, implement, and manage the deployment of operating system patches, updates, including third party software updates across Windows 10, 11 workstation environments using tools like MECM/MEMCM / BigFix, and PowerShell scripts.
* Complex Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve advanced system and patching issues that L1/L2 members escalate, ensuring developing/providing solution and stability.
* Workstation Administration: Manage and maintain Windows workstation environments, including patch management and vulnerability remediation.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure systems meet security standards, manage security policies, and maintain OS-level security compliance.
* Automation: Develop and implement automation for routine administrative and patching tasks, often using PowerShell.
* Patch Compliance and Optimization: Proactively monitor system patch health, performance, and availability, and implement enhancements to optimize resource allocation.
* Documentation & Reporting: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for patching procedures, troubleshooting steps, and generate performance reports.
* Collaboration & Mentorship: Working closely with various internal teams and OEM vendor to align with enterprise standards and address security threats and mentor junior members.
* Reporting: Prepare / report patch compliance reports /metrics as needed.
* Process/Standards: Adhere strictly to ITIL change, incident, and problem management for patch-related activities

**Skills And Qualification**

* Must have
* 8+ years of deep exposure in workstation patch management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance using various tools (BigFix, PowerShell scripting and Qualys).
* Strong knowledge of Windows 11 Operating Systems along with patch deployment and troubleshooting skills – Able to understand issues from log files.
* Advanced knowledge of BigFix architecture, deployment, and reporting.
* Strong knowledge over BigFix Baseline for patch deployments of workstation patches.
* Able to serve as the highest escalation point for complex issues that L1 and L2 support teams cannot resolve
* Strong understanding of third-party software updates (include Java) along with third party patching tools like PMPC, Ivanti etc.
* Strong proficiency in PowerShell for automation and system management; Should be able to create, modify, update complex scripts to build solutions.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to address complex technical issues.
* Understanding and exposure to vulnerability management tools (Qualys).
* In-depth understanding of patching best practices, compliance, and IT security standards.
* Identify, understand and collaborate with OEM/Vendors to resolve patch related issues
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and best practices
* Good to have
* Understanding of software package creation and deployments.
* Understanding and exposure to vulnerability management tools (Qualys)
* In-depth understanding of patching best practices, compliance, and IT security standards
* Identify, understand, and collaborate with OEM/Vendors to resolve patch related issues
* Experience working with Microsoft Endpoint Manager Configuration Manager (MEMCM) for device management and patching
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and best practices
* Soft Skills:
* Excellent written and verbal communication along with strong documentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated, with a "can-do" attitude and comfort working with ambiguity.
* Strong customer service skills and a customer-focused mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in the banking or financial services industry is a plus.
* Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies.
* Knowledge of network topology and security principles.
* Experience with enterprise applications specific to the banking industry.
* Knowledge of collaboration tools like Jira, or Confluence.

**Relationships & Collaboration**

* Be available for team connects if any.

title: Associate Principal Engineer - Threat Researcher
description:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit 

www.saviynt.com

.

Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

  

Saviynt is seeking a visionary and highly technical Senior Principal Threat Researcher to pioneer the future of Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR). In this senior-level role, you will be a cornerstone of our broader Threat Research Team, working in lockstep with Product Management and Engineering to architect and deliver Saviynt’s next-generation ITDR product.

  

You will lead from the front, anticipating how threat actors exploit infrastructure, and translating those insights into industry-leading detection capabilities and thought leadership.

**What will you be doing?**
  

  
* Spearhead Identity Threat Research: Lead advanced research initiatives focused on uncovering and understanding novel identity-centric vulnerabilities (Human Identity(HI), Non Human Identity(NHI), Agentic Identity) based attack vectors, and exploit chains across hybrid and multi-cloud environments
  
* Data-Driven Behavioral Modeling: Leverage vast telemetry from multi-cloud environments, disparate data sources, and user activity logs to conduct deep behavioral analysis. You will be a domain expert and work with an extended team to develop and refine sophisticated behavioral models to detect anomalies, uncovering stealthy, suspicious identity threat patterns that bypass traditional signature-based detection
  
* Drive Product Innovation: Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams to translate complex threat research into actionable product features, robust detection algorithms, and high-fidelity telemetry for our next-generation ITDR platform
  
* Execute Advanced Threat Hunting & Intelligence: Conduct proactive threat intelligence gathering and sophisticated threat hunting specifically targeting Identity vulnerabilities (e.g., Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, PAM, and Cloud IAM misconfigurations)
  
* Operationalize Security Frameworks: Extensively utilize and map research to industry-standard frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, and MAESTRO, ensuring our detection strategies comprehensively cover modern adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs)
  
* Pioneer Detection Engineering: Architect and develop advanced detection strategies, behavioral baselines, and correlation rules to identify anomalous identity behaviors, privilege escalation, and lateral movement
  
* Establish Thought Leadership: Serve as a highly visible ambassador for Saviynt’s research capabilities. You will regularly author and publish high-quality blogs, and technical reports on emerging threats
  
* Drive Patentable Innovation: Foster a culture of exemplary, bleeding-edge innovation within the team, actively pursuing research that leads to industry publications, CVE discoveries, and patents for Saviynt
  
* Mentor and Guide: Act as a senior technical authority, mentoring junior researchers and elevating the overall technical acumen of the Threat Research and Engineering organizations
  
  

  
**What you will bring?**
  

  
* Extensive Industry Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, with a minimum of 5+ years dedicated specifically to Threat Research, Threat Intelligence, or advanced Detection Engineering at a senior/lead level
  
* Technical & Analytical Skills:
  
  

  

  
* + Threat Intelligence Pivoting: Tracing connections between seemingly unrelated data points (e.g., IPs, domain names, hashes) to attribute attacks to specific threat actors or Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs)
    
  + Security Frameworks: Applying industry models to classify and map adversary behavior, such as the MITRE ATT&CK framework, ATLAS, and MAESTRO
    
  + Attack Vectors: Knowledge of Identity based attacks such as Pass-the-Hash/Ticket, Golden/Silver Tickets, MFA Fatigue (Prompt Bombing), Token Theft, Kerberosting and Credential Stuffing
    
  + Adversary Tradecraft: Familiarity with tools threat actors use to map and exploit identity environments, such as Mimikatz, BloodHound, Rubeus
    
  + Vulnerability & Exploit Research: Assessing zero-day flaws, evaluating proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits, and testing patching strategies
    
  + Programming & Scripting: Familiarity with scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) to help rapidly engineer complex detection algorithms and prototype innovative feature proof-of-concepts (POCs)
    
  + Data Mining & OSINT: Gathering threat intelligence from various sources like Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), dark web forums, threat feeds, and internal telemetry
    
  + Rule/Signature Development: Creating custom detection logic for monitoring platforms (e.g., building YARA or Snort rules), experience writing detection logic using SIEM query languages (Splunk SPL, KQL) or universal formats like Sigma
  
  

  

  
* AI/ML in Threat Research: Working knowledge of leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies to aid in threat research, scale threat hunting capabilities, or improve the fidelity of detection mechanisms, Agentic AI usage and understanding of the upcoming Agentic AI threats.
  
* A Portfolio of Excellence: A demonstrated track record of thought leadership, including published white papers, popular cybersecurity blogs, conference speaking engagements, patents, or acknowledged CVEs
  
* Cross-Functional Leadership Skills: Exceptional communication skills with the proven ability to distill complex, highly technical research into clear, actionable requirements for Product Management and Engineering teams
  
* Algorithmic Prototyping: Good-to-have skills in developing and prototyping complex detection algorithms, familiarity with advanced query languages used in data analysis
  
* Identity Security Expertise: Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and cloud identity architectures (AWS IAM, Azure AD/Entra ID, GCP Cloud Identity, Active Directory). Understanding how identity works in AWS (IAM Roles, Policies), GCP (Cloud Identity), and Azure
  
* Logistical Flexibility:
  
  

  

  
* + Willing to work in a Hybrid model from our Bengaluru office
    
  + Willingness to undertake some travel globally based on business requirements, industry conferences, and strategic team syncs

  

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

  

***Security & Compliance***
This role requires adherence to Saviynt’s information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training.
  
***Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.***

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: CPU/Cores Post‑Silicon Validation (Security)
description:

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
Cores Post‑Silicon Validation (Security)
  
  

* THE ROLE

The AMD Cores Validation team is looking for a highly motivated engineer to drive post-silicon validation of CPU security features across next-generation x86 processor products. The engineer will be responsible for validating architectural and microarchitectural security capabilities, developing security-focused test methodologies, executing validation plans, and driving complex debug activities from first silicon through production readiness.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to work closely with Architecture, Design, Firmware, Security, and Product Engineering teams to ensure robust implementation of processor security technologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for CPU security features.
* Validate architectural security capabilities including:

+ Secure Virtual Machine (SVM)
+ SEV / SEV-ES / SEV-SNP
+ Memory encryption technologies
+ Secure Boot
+ Trusted execution and attestation mechanisms
+ Speculation and side-channel mitigation features
+ Virtualization security extensions

* Design directed and stress workloads to verify security functionality, robustness, and corner-case behavior.
* Perform silicon bring-up and feature enablement on pre-production platforms.
* Debug failures spanning:

+ CPU cores and microarchitecture
+ Microcode (uCode)
+ BIOS/Firmware
+ Security processors and firmware

* Analyze logs, machine check data, MSRs, traces, and hardware debug information to isolate root causes.
* Collaborate with Design, Architecture, Security, and Firmware teams to drive issue resolution.
* Develop automation infrastructure to improve validation efficiency, coverage, and regression execution.
* Track validation coverage, defect metrics, and readiness criteria for product milestones.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture and x86 processors.
* Good knowledge of operating systems internals and virtualization technologies.
* Familiarity with processor security concepts such as:

+ Encryption
+ Authentication
+ Secure boot flows
+ Trust chains
+ Isolation mechanisms
+ Virtualization security

* Experience with silicon validation, system validation, or hardware validation.
* Strong debug and root-cause analysis skills.
* Proficiency in Python, C/C++, or scripting languages for automation.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in CPU cores post-silicon validation.
* Experience validating security IPs or processor security features.
* Knowledge of SEV, SNP, TSME, SME, Secure Boot, PSP/ASP architectures, or trusted execution technologies.
* Understanding of cache hierarchy, memory management, coherency protocols, and microarchitectural behavior.
* Familiarity with microcode, BIOS, firmware, and platform bring-up flows.
* Exposure to security testing methodologies including penetration, negative, and adversarial validation approaches.
* Experience with post-silicon debug tools, JTAG, trace, and performance monitoring infrastructure.

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering or related field

title: Senior Identity Engineer - IT Risk and Security
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
As Senior Identity Engineer for IT Risk and Security, you will be a senior hands-on engineer responsible for operating, improving, automating, securing and troubleshooting the enterprise identity platforms the firm depends on. The estate of platforms include Identity Providers, legacy directory services, enterprise PKI, privileged access management, modern authentication and identity governance tooling, alongside legacy platforms now being retired. This is a senior individual contributor role, not an architect role — the ideal candidate is deeply hands-on, comfortable owning complex, ambiguous identity problems end to end with minimal supervision, and raises the standard of the engineers around them. Experience working in a regulated financial environment is a plus.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary duties will include:**

* Design, build and operate identity services across core identity provider platforms—Entra ID with hybrid directory services and Okta—including authentication journeys, application integration, federation and single sign-on at scale; implement, test, troubleshoot and monitor access policies, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, authentication strengths, session controls, policy exclusions and emergency access safeguards.
* Operate and troubleshoot Active Directory in large, complex, multi-domain and multi-forest environments, including domain controllers, DNS and name resolution, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts and cross-domain authentication, service accounts, privileged groups, delegated access and domain health; coordinate changes across dependent systems.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex identity incidents — authentication failures, provisioning issues, certificate-related outages, privileged access problems and production change failures — determining cause, escalating anything with ongoing or immediate impact, performing root cause analysis and driving the problem to a permanent fix.
* Plan, execute, validate and document production identity changes, including risk assessment, implementation steps, rollback planning, stakeholder coordination, functional and connectivity testing, and post-change monitoring.
* Grow the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle — provisioning and deprovisioning driven from authoritative HR sources, and policy and role-based entitlement in place of ticket-by-ticket approval.
* Support PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services — TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Automate repeatable identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, source control and pipeline-based workflows, applying configuration-as-code to identity change rather than manual administration.
* Develop group policies and access control lists, design and build system administration and management functionality for privileged access users, maintain baseline system security, and resolve vulnerabilities in identity systems and components through documented remediation plans.
* Maintain the resilience of the service: define availability levels, determine disaster recovery and continuity of operations requirements, and develop, test and execute recovery and alternate-site procedures for identity platforms.
* Own operational documentation for the identity services you support — SOPs, runbooks, implementation records, troubleshooting guides, escalation procedures, known-error documentation and workflow diagrams — kept current with the deployed design and to a standard that allows work to move between regions without loss.
* Produce audit-ready evidence for identity controls — privileged access, access reviews, account lifecycle events, group membership, policy changes, app permissions, certificate ownership and remediation actions — supporting internal audit, external audit and client or scheme assessments including SWIFT CSP, defending design decisions and closing findings to agreed dates.
* Collect metrics and trending data, develop cybersecurity and performance success metrics, and examine service performance reports for issues and variances so identity risk is visible without a manual data pull.
* Mentor and upskill engineers across the team through code and design reviews, interactive training and knowledge transfer, building genuine cover so that every platform has more than one engineer, in more than one region, who can safely operate it.
* Establish internal and external cross-team relationships — with security architecture, security operations, enterprise IT, HR, compliance and application teams — to gather requirements, translate proposed capabilities into technical requirements and deliver identity solutions that meet business needs.

**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need:**

* This individual must be capable of working with internal and customer-facing teams to facilitate process improvement and customer support resulting in an enhanced security posture, reduction in risk and improvement in end-user experience. Excellent communication, strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential.
* 5+ years in identity and access management in a hands-on engineering or operations role, with a track record of independently delivering complex identity change in a large, distributed estate; experience in financial services a plus.
* Deep, current, hands-on experience operating Active Directory in large, complex environments — domain controllers, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts, service accounts, privileged groups and domain health troubleshooting — including multi-domain or multi-forest estates with cross-domain authentication and delegated access.
* Equivalent depth in Microsoft Entra ID — tenant configuration, directory synchronization, conditional access, privileged role management, entitlement models, enterprise applications and app registrations — and in Okta, covering policy architecture, authentication journeys, application integration, lifecycle management and federation at scale.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across authentication, authorization, federation, directory synchronization, MFA, Conditional Access, certificates, DNS, LDAP, Kerberos, SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SCIM.
* Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services, including TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated experience governing non-human identities — service accounts, managed identities, app registrations, API clients and automation accounts — including secrets and certificate handling, ownership records, permission reviews and decommissioning.
* Strong automation ability using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, including the Okta management APIs, with practical use of source control, pipelines and configuration-as-code applied to identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation.
* Knowledge and implementation of key security concepts such as RBAC, zero trust, identity lifecycle automation, least privilege and identity governance.
* Expert command of change management process and discipline; you are expected to plan, document and execute high-risk identity change on production platforms with minimal guidance, including rollback planning and post-change validation.
* Demonstrated operational engineering discipline: incident, problem and change management, root cause analysis, service level reporting, and the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, runbooks and known-error documentation.
* Direct experience supporting identity controls through audit — preparing evidence, defending design decisions to auditors or regulators, and closing findings.
* Understanding of a broad range of general information security domains, including networking, cybersecurity, governance and risk, and cloud.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, sufficient to explain identity design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, answer requests for information directly, and communicate critical or time-sensitive information to leadership.
* Experience with a cohesive PAM/IGA program

**What makes you stand out**
:
  
  

* You have an engineer's instinct; you see an inefficient process and immediately think of how to automate it away rather than staff it.
* You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are comfortable carrying live service ownership and a delivery backlog at the same time.
* You are equally comfortable in both platforms and can reason about where a capability belongs — Entra ID or Okta — rather than defaulting to the one you know best.
* You are the person others escalate to, and you close the loop by documenting what you found so the next engineer does not have to rediscover it.
* You leave the estate better documented and better understood than you found it, and you deliberately build capability in the engineers around you.
* You have experience in a Zero Trust program, or with securing non-human identities including service accounts, workload identities and emerging agentic and AI workloads.
* Education / Certification Requirements:
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information security or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) preferred.
* Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Administrator preferred; Okta Certified Consultant a plus.
* CISSP, CISM, CyberArk Defender or Sentry, or an equivalent identity governance credential preferred; ITIL foundation or equivalent service management training is a plus.
* Significant experience with demonstrated examples of growing PAM and/or IGA programs
* Production delivery experience across at least three of: identity governance and administration tooling, privileged access management such as CyberArk, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, federation and single sign-on, and multi-factor or passwordless authentication.

**Working environment**
:
  
  

* Team distributed across UK, US and GCC locations; expected business start time (2:00 - 2:30 PM IST) to overlap some of US business hours and participation in an escalation and on-call rotation should be expected.
* 4 days' a week in office.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role:**

You will set the security direction for the whole platform and build much of it with your own hands. This is a hands-on Staff+ role: you write code, review designs, and lead incidents, not only policy.

Your mandate covers four things:

1. **Protect customer credentials and data**
   across a multi-tenant platform and every deployment model we ship.
2. **Make AI agents safe to connect**
   to enterprise systems, from prompt injection to tool-permission scope.
3. **Harden how we build and ship**
   , from the monorepo and CI to the images and Helm charts customers run in their own clusters.
4. **Turn security into a sales advantage**
   by owning the technical side of enterprise security reviews and our compliance program.

You will work across every engineering team, partner with product and go-to-market, and help hire and grow the security function.

**What you'll do:**

**Cloud and infrastructure security**

* Harden our GCP and GKE footprint: IAM, workload identity, network policy, egress control and private control planes.
* Own secrets and key management end to end, including rotation, short-lived credentials and KMS-backed encryption.
* Build runtime security for containers and nodes, so a compromised workload is detected and contained fast.

**Product and application security**

* Threat-model the integration engine, credential vault, workflow runtime and webhook surface, and drive the fixes.
* Guarantee tenant isolation across shared data stores, queues and workflow engines.
* Design safe execution for customer-authored code and custom actions.
* Raise the bar on authentication and access: SSO, SCIM, RBAC, API keys and OAuth flows.

**AI and agent security**

* Define how AI agents get scoped, auditable access to enterprise systems through our MCP servers and AI gateway.
* Defend against prompt injection, tool misuse and data exfiltration through agents.

**Software supply chain**

* Secure the monorepo, CI pipelines and release process: branch protection, signed and provenance-attested images, SBOMs and dependency scanning.
* Make the images and Helm charts that customers install in their own clusters trustworthy and easy to verify.

**Detection and incident response**

* Build logging, detection and alerting that catch real attacks, with low noise.
* Lead security incidents end to end: triage, forensics, containment, customer communication and the post-incident fix.

**Customer trust and compliance**

* Be the senior technical voice in enterprise security reviews, questionnaires and customer calls.
* Run SOC 2 and ISO 27001 as engineering work: automate evidence, own pen-test scoping and drive remediation.
* Publish hardening guidance for customers who self-host or run Refold in their own cloud.

**Leadership**

* Build paved roads so the secure way is the easy way for every engineer.
* Mentor engineers, run a security-champions program, and help hire the security team.

**What we're looking for:**

* Typically 8+ years in security or software engineering, including several years as the senior security engineer for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
* Deep cloud and Kubernetes security experience. GCP and GKE preferred; strong AWS or Azure depth is fine.
* Strong application security: threat modelling, secure design review, and code review in at least one of TypeScript/Node.js, Python or Go.
* Fluency with OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML, secrets management, key management and encryption design.
* You have led real production security incidents, including forensics and customer communication.
* Hands-on software supply chain work: CI/CD hardening, artefact signing, SBOMs and dependency risk.
* You write production-quality code and ship tooling, not only recommendations.
* You have represented a company's security in front of enterprise security teams, and won their trust.
* You can turn SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls into engineering systems instead of spreadsheets.
* Clear, direct writing. You explain risk to engineers, executives and customers in their own terms.

**Bonus points:**

* Security work on LLM and agent systems: OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, MCP, tool-use permissions.
* Sandboxing and isolation for untrusted code, such as gVisor, Firecracker or V8 isolates.
* Shipping software that customers run in their own environments: BYOC, on-prem, air-gapped.
* Securing workflow engines and data stores such as Temporal, MongoDB, Redis and PostgreSQL.
* Background in integration platforms, iPaaS, or enterprise systems like SAP, Workday or Salesforce.
* Offensive security experience, published research, CVEs or open-source security tooling.
* HIPAA or other regulated-data experience.
* You have built a security team from the first hire.

* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

:

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer - Endpoint Security (Cortex XDR/XSIAM)
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Senior Technical Support Engineer for Focused Services - XDR, you will be a dedicated partner to our customers, ensuring their success with our Cortex XDR products. You will leverage your deep technical expertise to proactively mitigate risks, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide personalized support as a virtual member of their team. This role is pivotal in managing escalations, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with internal teams to drive swift resolutions and enhance the customer experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Respond to and triage user-reported issues via ticketing system, phone, or remote sessions, adhering to established Service Level Agreements.
  
  
Perform advanced, multi-level troubleshooting at the application and OS level to isolate and resolve complex technical problems.
  
  
Collaborate effectively with development and other teams to identify fault areas (code, environment, configuration) and drive the implementation of fixes.
  
  
Facilitate comprehensive root cause investigations and manage the implementation of corrective and preventative measures to prevent future occurrences.
  
  
Proactively engage with customers to address Cortex XDR technical needs and provide escalation management for enterprise deployment issues.
  
  
Document all actions and solutions meticulously in tracking systems and account-specific repositories to ensure alignment and knowledge sharing.
  
  
Reproduce customer issues in a lab environment to assist developers in resolving technical challenges and provide timely product feedback.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, a related technical field, equivalent military experience, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Relevant experience in a technical support, systems engineering, or similar role with a focus on customer service.
  
  
Demonstrated experience with endpoint security technologies such as XDR, SOAR, or SIEM.
  
  
Expertise in troubleshooting and debugging applications on Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems.
  
  
Strong experience with Microsoft environments (SCCM, GPO, AD, MSSQL, IIS) and a fundamental understanding of malware and exploits.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience with bash or Python scripting for automation and analysis.
  
  
Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and VDI environments (e.g., VMware, Citrix).
  
  
Experience with additional security tools like Antivirus, DLP, IPS, and NAC.
  
  
Experience troubleshooting Android OS based applications.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid day shift role for a Cyber Security Analyst focuses on assessing and managing technology risk across enterprise systems while supporting business operations. The analyst will apply deep risk management experience to safeguard critical assets strengthen control environments and reduce exposure to evolving cyber threats. Experience in check processing domains is beneficial for understanding financial transaction risks and ensuring secure compliant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assess enterprise technology environments to identify cyber risks and control gaps applying risk management practices to prioritize remediation efforts that protect critical systems and data.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive risk registers that clearly document vulnerabilities threat scenarios impact ratings and mitigation plans to support transparent risk decisions by stakeholders.
* Conduct detailed risk assessments for new and existing applications infrastructure changes and third party services to ensure cyber risk is evaluated before deployment or integration.
* Collaborate with security engineering and operations teams to define practical risk reduction actions translate findings into clear requirements and ensure mitigation steps align with business needs.
* Monitor security alerts risk indicators and incident trends to detect emerging risk patterns and provide timely recommendations that strengthen defenses and reduce recurrence.
* Coordinate periodic control testing and validation activities to verify that implemented risk treatments are effective measurable and aligned with internal standards and regulatory obligations.
* Prepare concise risk reports and dashboards for management that highlight key risk drivers residual exposure levels and the progress of remediation initiatives across technology domains.
* Support policy and standard development by providing input based on observed risks and incidents ensuring that documented expectations are practical and aligned with recognized security frameworks.
* Advise project teams during system design and change initiatives to embed appropriate security controls ensuring risk considerations are addressed early and reducing the need for costly rework.
* Engage with business stakeholders to explain cyber risk in clear terms enabling informed decisions that balance protective measures with operational efficiency and customer impact.
* Apply knowledge of payment and transaction flows especially in check processing environments to identify fraud and operational risks and propose control enhancements that secure financial operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting lessons learned from assessments and near miss events recommending updates to risk methodologies tools and processes for better outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and current documentation of risk management activities methodologies and outcomes to support audits compliance reviews and organizational learning.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate five to seven years of professional experience in cyber security roles focused on risk management including practical exposure to risk assessment mitigation planning and control evaluation.
* Possess strong knowledge of core risk management concepts such as likelihood analysis impact determination control effectiveness and residual risk calculation within technology environments.
* Apply familiarity with industry security frameworks and standards using them as references for designing and assessing controls across applications networks and data handling processes.
* Exhibit analytical skills to interpret complex technical information security alerts and vulnerability data translating them into understandable risk statements and prioritized actions.
* Utilize excellent communication abilities to prepare clear documentation risk reports and stakeholder updates that support decision making and foster shared understanding of cyber exposures.
* Bring working knowledge of financial or payment processing domains including check processing to enhance understanding of transaction risks and to guide secure process and system design.

title: Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Job Position:**
Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst serves as a senior member of the Cyber Threat Intelligence program and is responsible for independently collecting, analyzing, enriching, and disseminating actionable intelligence on emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, and evolving attack trends. This role transforms complex technical and strategic threat information into actionable insights that support security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise risk decisions.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in cyber threat intelligence tradecraft, threat actor tracking, infrastructure analysis, and intelligence production. They operate with minimal supervision, lead complex intelligence investigations, provide authoritative threat assessments, and serve as a trusted advisor to technical teams and leadership. Success requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, technical curiosity, and the ability to communicate intelligence effectively across a broad range of stakeholders.
  
  
Your Opportunity
  
  
NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.
  
  
Job Responsibility
  
  

* Monitor and assess emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, malware campaigns, and vulnerability exploitation trends.
* Track threat actors and analyze their capabilities, targeting, infrastructure, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Conduct technical investigations using threat intelligence, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and infrastructure analysis techniques.
* Correlate intelligence from multiple sources and assess potential impact to the organization.
* Lead indicator of compromise (IOC) collection, enrichment, validation, and lifecycle management activities.
* Maintain intelligence records, indicators, and threat artifacts within the organization’s Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP).
* Develop and disseminate actionable threat advisories, intelligence reports, and emerging threat notifications.
* Support intelligence-sharing efforts with internal stakeholders and trusted external partners.
* Produce tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and business audiences.
* Deliver intelligence briefings to security teams, leadership, and other stakeholders.
* Provide threat-informed recommendations that improve organizational awareness and preparedness.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on adversary activity, emerging threats, and cyber risk trends.
* Provide intelligence support during cybersecurity investigations and incident response activities.
* Perform adversary-focused analysis to support incident scoping, attribution, and impact assessments.
* Partner with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, and Risk teams to provide threat context and intelligence insights.
* Identify intelligence gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities to strengthen defensive capabilities.

Job Qualification
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Research, Incident Response, Security Operations, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience tracking threat actors, malware campaigns, adversary infrastructure, and emerging cyber threats.
* Experience producing tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and executive audiences.
* Proven ability to independently conduct investigations, develop actionable intelligence, and brief stakeholders.
* Familiarity with nation-state actors, sophisticated cybercriminal groups, and supply chain threats.
* Experience in intelligence-driven hunting to identify suspicious network activity and potential risks.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of threat intelligence tradecraft, intelligence lifecycle methodologies, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies including MITRE ATT&CK, ATT&CK Navigator, Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, STIX/TAXII, Intelligence Lifecycle, and Structured Analytic Techniques.
* Experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms such as Anomali, ThreatQ, ThreatConnect, OpenCTI, MISP, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency with intelligence and OSINT tools such as Maltego, VirusTotal, Shodan, Censys, DomainTools, PassiveTotal, GreyNoise, URLScan, SecurityTrails, or similar investigative platforms.
* Knowledge of threat actor clustering methodologies used to track adversary campaigns, intrusion sets, and threat group activity.
* Experience conducting infrastructure analysis involving domains, DNS, passive DNS, IP addresses, ASNs, WHOIS records, certificates, hosting providers, and internet-facing assets.
* Familiarity with STIX/TAXII, YARA, Sigma, Snort, Suricata, malware analysis concepts, and intelligence automation techniques.
* Experience with Python, data mining, Elasticsearch, ELK Stack, Databricks, large-scale data analysis, and threat intelligence correlation workflows.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and technical curiosity.
* Strong communication and technical writing skills.
* Ability to communicate intelligence effectively to technical, business, and leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to operate with minimal supervision and lead complex intelligence investigations.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Industry certifications such as GCTI, CTIA, GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, or equivalent cybersecurity and threat intelligence certifications.

description:

What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
  
  
**Who We Are**
Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.
  
  
Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.
  
  
With over 1,400+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.
  
  
Job Summary: As a Security Engineer II on the Active Operational Defender track you will build hands on experience across penetration testing, threat detection and incident response, working under the direction of senior and lead engineers. You will support live operational work within a high velocity fintech environment, developing the manual testing and detection engineering skills needed to take on more independent responsibility over time. Responsibilities and Tasks: 1. Offensive Penetration Testing & Red Teaming Support penetration testing engagements across financial platforms and product architectures under senior guidance, building practical exploit research experience. Assist with manual security reviews including source code audits, API testing and cloud configuration checks, working towards independent delivery of smaller engagements. Contribute to adversarial testing of AI features where in scope, learning to identify prompt injection and related LLM specific weaknesses. 2. Threat Detection Engineering & SIEM Help design and tune detection rules and alert workflows within the enterprise SIEM, working from senior engineers' guidance and established detection frameworks. Support SecOps in reviewing detection coverage against current threats, referencing frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK. 3. Incident Response & Forensics Act as a first line responder during active security incidents, carrying out evidence collection and initial triage under senior direction. Support post incident analysis by pulling together logs, timelines and technical findings for senior review. 4. Cross Functional Collaboration & Development Take part in security operations and engineering planning to build a practical understanding of detection and response capability. Communicate findings from testing and incidents clearly to immediate team members and stakeholders. Actively seek mentorship from senior and lead security engineers on offensive tooling, detection engineering and incident response practice.

Competitive compensation
  
  
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  
  
Competitive time off
  
  
Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media

Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact

title: Product Security Engineer, Agentic AI
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Own security architecture and threat modeling for the agentic AI offering as a core part of the product roadmap, from early design through general availability and sustaining engineering.
* Build guardrails, sandboxing, and hardening directly into the product: agent tool-calling, prompt handling, and data access paths engineered in, not audited after the fact.
* Participate in design reviews and sprint planning alongside the engineers building agent orchestration, integrations, and platform features; security is planned and estimated like any other engineering work, not a separate gate.
* Write and maintain the product’s living threat model, using frameworks including OWASP’s LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, updated every release rather than once a year.
* Review teammates’ code and architecture for security issues, including tool-calling risk, prompt injection, excessive agency, and data exfiltration, as a standard part of the team’s engineering process.
* Build the product’s governance and access control features, including agent identity, least-privilege permissions, and audit logging, as shippable capabilities of the product itself rather than side tooling.
* Own production security for the shipped product in managed services: monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management for live deployments.
* Publish reference architectures and paved-road patterns that let pre-sales and delivery teams field the product safely, extending OAE’s mission of arming field teams with field-ready IP.
* Contribute to product roadmap and prioritization decisions from a security and reliability lens, the same way any senior engineer on the team would.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience as a product or platform engineer with a security specialization, or as a security engineer who has shipped production features as part of a product engineering team, with strong coding proficiency (for example, Python or Go).
* We are looking for a CISSP certification with a specialization in Agentic AI. We care about what you have built and what you can do; self-taught practitioners and career changers are welcome.
* A genuine AI builder: you have shipped agents, tools, or automations with large language models as part of a real product and can walk through the hard parts.
* Experience building real backends and infrastructure, not just demos: APIs, data pipelines, authentication and secrets management, hosting and deployment (containers, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD), and systems integration, made reliable with observability, evaluations, and graceful failure handling.
* Deep knowledge of the AI threat landscape, including frameworks such as OWASP’s LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, with practical experience addressing prompt injections, excessive agency, and related agentic AI risks.
* Experience securing or auditing agentic frameworks and tool-calling or MCP-style integrations operating in sandboxed environments.
* Proven ability to design scalable cloud infrastructure, API gateways, proxy architecture, and access controls for enterprise systems.
* Comfortable working within a product team’s sprint cadence, design review process, and release cycle, contributing as a shipping engineer rather than an embedded auditor.
* Enough software and security foundation to build and secure production systems, with sound judgment on data handling and safe AI usage.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience as a product or feature engineer who happens to specialize in security, rather than a security specialist who occasionally writes code.
* Experience with AI governance, data loss prevention, monitoring and logging, or guardrail tooling for AI usage at product scale.
* Experience building and hosting AI solutions in the cloud.
* A security background in application security, cloud security, or data protection.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
* Track record building developer-first security tools and platform controls that preserve engineering velocity.
* Experience mentoring engineers or driving technical alignment across security, platform, and product teams.
* Experience enabling field or partner teams, such as pre-sales, delivery, or professional services, to safely adopt a shipped product.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

title: Network Security Engineer | Enterprise Support | SaaS | Linux | API |  IOT Security Platform
description:
We are looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer with strong networking, Linux troubleshooting, and SaaS integration skills. You will own complex customer issues end-to-end, lead critical escalations, perform evidence-based root cause analysis, and collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to deliver effective resolutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Own complex technical issues from initial triage through resolution, documentation, and customer follow-up.
* Troubleshoot enterprise networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, SNMP, and network traffic visibility.
* Analyze logs, packet captures, system behavior, and API responses to identify root causes.
* Troubleshoot Linux-based systems, services, processes, resource utilization, and network connectivity.
* Resolve issues involving REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, SAML/OAuth authentication, SSL/TLS certificates, and third-party integrations.
* Lead high-priority customer escalations, coordinate with Engineering and Product teams, and communicate resolution plans clearly.
* Reproduce customer issues and provide detailed technical evidence, including logs, packet captures, and troubleshooting steps.
* Develop knowledge base articles, technical documentation, and runbooks to improve support efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 6+ years of experience in Technical Support Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, SRE, or related roles.
* Strong hands-on networking and troubleshooting expertise across TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, SNMP, and network traffic analysis.
* Strong Linux command-line skills, log analysis, and system-level debugging.
* Experience with Wireshark, tcpdump, curl, Postman, and REST API troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, SAML/OAuth, SSL/TLS certificates, and SaaS integrations.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, production incidents, and high-severity customer escalations.
* Excellent customer communication, technical documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, or vCenter.
* Exposure to IoT/IoMT, OT security, cybersecurity, or network visibility platforms.
* Familiarity with Kafka, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, or distributed systems.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk, or similar support tools.

title: Assistant Security Analyst
description:
We’re a growing team, and as we scale, so does our need to focus on expanding our Security & Compliance team. You'll be joining a people-focused company, and as an Assistant Security Analyst, you will work alongside experienced security professionals to monitor, triage, and respond to security events, while building a strong foundation for a long-term career in cybersecurity. You will get exposure to highly sophisticated, latest-generation security tools and technologies such as NextGen SIEM, EDR, CSPM, DSPM, ASPM, EASM, DLP, Identity Protection, PAM, Vulnerability Management platforms, AI security platforms, and Cloud Security, along with multiple compliance frameworks. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will learn how these technologies come together to protect our people, data, and customers, and you will grow in a collaborative, learning-focused environment.
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**

* This is an entry-level (L0-L1) role suited to freshers or candidates with up to 3 years of experience, responsible for day-to-day security monitoring, alert handling, incident triaging, and reporting across a range of security and monitoring platforms. The role may be needed to operate in a 24x7 shift environment, as business requires.
* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of security alerts, including identification, categorization, prioritization, escalation, closure, reporting, and documentation.
* Generate periodic reports, build and maintain a centralized dashboard, and explore secure automation opportunities.
* Coordinate across functions to drive closure of risks, events, and incidents.
* Assist in various compliance activities such as ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 42001, NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, CIS, and CCM.
* Other duties as assigned.

**THE SKILL SET**

* Basic understanding of networking, operating systems, OSI layers, common protocols, and common threat vectors.

* Intermediate-level hands-on exposure to Generative AI platforms for automation, analysis, reporting, and similar tasks.

title: Administrator - Networks
description:
**We create possibilities that move life and commerce forward**
Welcome to Manhattan. Every day, our supply chain commerce technology connects two billion people to 20 billion consumer choices. In the warehouse, on the road and in the store, we make what was once impossible, possible. If you want to tackle complex problems and redefine markets, you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**Network Security Engineer II**
**Position Summary**
The Network Security Engineer II is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and improving the security of Manhattan’s on-premises and cloud environments. This role focuses on operational security engineering, network security administration, incident response, access control, certificate and secret management, and continuous risk reduction.
  
  
This position operates within a Tier 2 security engineering model and supports a broad range of security services, including VPN services, firewall policy administration, certificate-related activities, Cisco ISE, and security incidents managed through ServiceNow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor, investigate, and respond to security events, alerts, and operational incidents, and support remediation efforts in alignment with established service level agreements.
* Support and troubleshoot network security services, including remote access VPN, site-to-site VPN tunnels, firewall policy changes, URL filtering or allowlisting requests, and access control workflows.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco security technologies, including Cisco ISE, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, and related tools used to secure enterprise connectivity and user or device access.
* Assist with reviewing infrastructure and application changes for security risk, help identify corrective actions, and help maintain secure configurations across on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Support certificate, secret, and identity-integrated security processes across enterprise platforms, including cross-functional controls.
* Create and maintain accurate technical documentation, incident records, implementation notes, and operational handoff details within but not limited to ServiceNow and related support processes.
* Collaborate with Tier 1 and Tier 3 security teams, infrastructure teams, directory services, cloud teams, and application teams to resolve issues and implement secure solutions.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts to strengthen operational efficiency, standardization, and security posture across supported services.

**Typical Technology Exposure**

* Cisco ASA and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) firewall administration and policy management
* Remote access VPN and site-to-site IPsec VPN configuration and troubleshooting
* Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
* Cisco Umbrella / Secure Access
* Splunk or similar SIEM platforms
* Cisco Secure Cloud Analytics (XDR)
* Cloud network security in Azure
* Certificate and client secret lifecycle support
* ServiceNow-based incident, request, and escalation handling

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in network security engineering, network security operations, or a closely related cybersecurity role
* At least 1 year of experience with cloud security, cloud networking, or cloud platform security concepts
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, switching, and core network security principles
* Hands-on troubleshooting experience with IPsec VPN and remote access VPN technologies
* Good understanding of encryption concepts, certificate lifecycle management, authentication flows, and secure access principles
* Experience working with Cisco security technologies such as ISE, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and VPN
* Familiarity with cloud-integrated security operations and hybrid enterprise environments
* Ability to troubleshoot security issues with guidance as needed and coordinate resolution across multiple teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with network or security automation
* Experience working in an enterprise operational environment with formal incident, request, and change processes
* Familiarity with Microsoft cloud security integrations and identity-dependent security services
* Experience with vulnerability remediation coordination and operational risk reduction activities

**Core Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage tasks independently and escalate appropriately
* Ability to work effectively across multiple technical teams in a fast-paced support environment
* Strong attention to detail in incident and request handling
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism

**Education and Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Cisco security or networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, or equivalent are preferred
